protocol_sources.source_limit: Local2025.2 package had interface metadata but no PG149 PDF discovered. Official PG149 references corroborate protocol; exact generated2025.2 reload packet profile remains to be bound.

loading.order: load_begin snapshots nonzero version, reload_count, config_count, expected CRC. Subsequent accepted32-bit words are complete RELOAD packet followed by complete CONFIG packet, both already in IP-specific order.
loading.crc: CRC32C polynomial0x82f63b78 reflected, init0xffffffff final complement, low byte/bit first across every32-bit container word including CONFIG. Unused upper bits above configured AXIS width must be zero.
loading.ownership: Only inactive bank is written. bank_ref_busy blocks begin and every write to that bank. Partial/CRC-bad tables never set loaded. Version cannot equal current active_version.
loading.control: Commands are strobes, and loader must issue load_valid only when load_ready. Conflicting begin/write/commit strobes reject. While busy, new begin/commit rejects and cannot mutate snapshots.
loading.version_freeze: candidate_version/lengths/CRC snapshotted at BEGIN; input changes afterward cannot alter committed version or packet lengths

commit.admission: commit requires complete verified candidate and known FIR reset state. It freezes loading and raises quiesce_request.
commit.boundary: Wait for safe_boundary and both bank_ref_busy bits clear before offering first RELOAD word. Caller must block new references for the entire quiesce_request interval. Native ADC sampling must continue; no ordinary ADC backpressure is implied. The boundary is a grant to keep coefficient-dependent output/jobs safe until quiesce_request drops; it is not permission to admit new pulses while a stalled update is pending.
commit.axis: Each RELOAD/CONFIG tvalid remains asserted across stalls; word/index/TLAST advance only on ready. RELOAD precedes CONFIG. Each packet marks only final word TLAST. There is no timeout withdrawal of an offered transaction.
commit.activation: RELOAD does not activate coefficients. active_valid clears before CONFIG is offered because the old active mapping may transition. Final CONFIG handshake only enters WAIT_APPLY. commit_done/active_version/new active_bank_id occur only on subsequent apply_confirmed.
commit.apply_confirmed: Authoritative external event from validated FIR synchronization/consumption instrumentation, not config_ready, software plan, guessed fixed delay or testbench tied-high constant. Tie low until this path exists.

errors_and_reset.ip_events: OR actual FIR reload_tlast_missing/unexpected into ip_reload_error; OR applicable config TLAST errors into ip_config_error.
errors_and_reset.fault: Any IP error invalidates active_valid, sets reset_required, and disallows further updates. An already offered packet drains with stable AXIS fields through final handshake or is canceled only by coordinated reset. No error path emits commit_done or publishes a new active version.
errors_and_reset.recovery: rst clears bridge knowledge. Before any load, fir_reset_done must confirm the actual attached FIR has reset and discarded pending packets. fir_reset_done cancels local candidate/inflight transfer and invalidates version; it does not claim startup coefficients have a known version.
errors_and_reset.limitations: Both rst and fir_reset_done must be driven by a coordinated trusted reset controller. A bridge-only reset cannot prove an external FIR discarded partially received packets.
